plugins.title: Context Diet
plugins.description:
Almost nothing an agent charges you for is what it writes — it is the conversation so far, read again, on every turn. This ships three workers pinned to the model each job needs (find, build, check) so the reading happens where it is not re-read, and a `read`-scope panel that keeps the tally: not how many turns are large, but how much of all the re-reading those turns carry.

It is one plugin with two halves — the panel here, and skills and agents in Claude Code — because two different programs

plugins.title: Jev Inbox
plugins.description: Scores each new Inbox notification with TypeSafe's Jev model — does it need you, and how urgently — and shows a needs-you badge and an optional sort order. Off until you add your own TypeSafe key and tick that the notification title leaves this machine; links, names, emails and secrets are removed first, and comments, code and authors are never sent. It only badges and orders: nothing is hidden or marked read.

plugins.title: Local Review
plugins.description: Reviews your pull requests on this machine with the agent and model you choose, inside a sandbox that cannot write or reach GitHub, and puts the findings in the pull request view. Nothing is posted. This update (commit 95b38144b67f19853bd71a5515d9e073c4f987c3) sees a new label within a minute (fresh list, 60 s poll), acts at once on the app's pr-changed event, and never skips a labelled pull request silently.
